description: Search the catalogue of public data sources (weather, water, hazards, flights, ships, energy, filings, trade, ...). Each entry gives the API, coverage, cadence, auth needed and licence. Use it to find where a kind of data comes from before writing a fetcher.

fetchable.description: true: only sources this server can fetch now; false: only catalogued ones.

query.description: Words matched against name, id, coverage, topics and licence note.

topic.description: One topic, e.g. weather, water, fires, flights, energy.

name: search_sources
